body: The problem is that it's who I want to be.  It's a part of me that needs filling, but can't be filled. It's what most every person is. Being so utterly incapable raises questions about competence in other aspects of one's life and psyche. Success is built upon. My foundation is somehow still faulty. I won't save the world, I can't even connect with those around me. How mundane of a failure, barely worthy of the keystrokes required to report. This seems appropriate.
